navDesc.reports: Counts and totals from your processes and records

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Build a report on any process or record type: choose columns, filter, group and total. Reports use the fields marked “reportable”.
reports.noneBody: Make the first one: pick a process or a record type and group it the way you want to see it.
reports.noneShared: Nobody has shared a report with you yet.
reports.name: Name of the report
reports.deleteBody: People it is shared with will no longer see it.
reports.noSources: There is nothing to report on yet. Publish a process or make a record type first.
reports.pending: Older records are still being copied for: {{fields}}. Numbers may be incomplete for a few minutes.

b.sourceHint: A process or one of your record types.
b.noReportable: This source has no reportable fields yet. Mark fields “reportable” in its form to use them here; until then you can use the number, title, status, date and person.
b.columnsHint: The columns of the list. Tap to add or take off.
b.columnsGrouped: A grouped report shows one row per group, so it has no columns of its own.
b.filtersHint: Only records that pass every filter are counted.
b.groupHint: One row per value: by customer, by month, by status …
b.totalsHint: What to work out for each group, and for the whole report.
b.shareHint: People with these roles can open the report (they can't change it). They see only what they may see in its source.

s.title: Send it by itself
s.hint: The people chosen get a message with the report's numbers and a link, at this time (company time).
s.monthDay: On which day of the month
